admission.justification: Enforces KNO-R13@v1 AC-1.1 supply-chain pinning across lockfile, catalog parser, and provider versioning, ensuring presentation-only highlight query edits never invalidate citation anchor hashes or broaden symbol-extraction languages.

applicability: Bundled language_catalog.lock.json parsing, CatalogLanguageSpec / LanguageCatalog display lookup, and TreeSitterLanguageProvider version hashing across all catalog and custom languages.
conditions: Every catalog highlightsQueries entry pins a packaged .scm path and exact SHA-256 digest verified at catalog load time.

Display-only highlightLanguages (8 language_pack entries plus yaml display_only) and displaySuffixes (.pyi -> python) are indexed separately from anchoring languages so symbol-citation admission is unchanged.
TreeSitterLanguageProvider hashes highlight queries into highlight_version independently of _version so EXTRACTOR_VERSION remains invariant when highlight queries change.
exclusions: Symbol-citation anchoring eligibility (tagsQuery / testsQuery and 76 admitted anchoring languages).
Runtime highlighting execution, caching, or UI rendering (covered by AC-1.2 and AC-3).

evidence: mcp/tests/test_unified_tree_sitter_highlights.py::HighlightEngineUnitTests::test_highlight_version_is_independent_of_extractor_version (152 passed, 235 subtests passed on clean-copy tree 8e2b8ed2889265fea2a81be8c3fb8e889a194990)

statement: Tree-sitter syntax highlight queries are provider-matched, SHA-256 pinned in language_catalog.lock.json (with presentation-only highlightLanguages and displaySuffixes separate from anchoring languages), and never alter EXTRACTOR_VERSION.
title: Highlight queries are hash-pinned separately without changing EXTRACTOR_VERSION
